newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market not well tested-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market not well tested-USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested, compared with Monday's close, USDA said. Trade was very slow. Demand light. Seller interest light to moderate. Offerings light.
Steers - Select and Choice 2-4 no sales.
Heifers - Select and Choice 2-4 no sales.

On a carcass basis (weight only) compared Monday's close, slaughter steers and heifers fully 1.00 lower in a light test. Steers - Select and Choice 2-4 1150-1300 lbs few 113.00-115.00 few Select, end Choice 112.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs few 105.00-107.00 Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales. Heifers - Select and Choice 2-4 1050-1175 lbs 113.00-115.00 ld Select, end Choice 112.00.
